limitations: Selection used development evaluation only, before test inference freeze.
Eight queries are conditional on detected and evaluable produced segments.
This fixed-pool comparison does not measure undetected people or global identity.
The test fixture has previously supported integration regression, not sealed holdout.
Synthetic accuracy does not establish cross-place generalization or formal readiness.

pixels_and_local_identity.segment_assignment: Dominant known pixel identity purity>=0.70; unresolved retained

selection_reason: RGB + feasibility-ratio space retained legacy time and equal weights. Both RGB+space and RGB+time hit all 8 development queries; the selected policy avoids adding a new temporal scale. The all-new combination and weighted options were retained as regressions, not used to promise test improvement.
